LanguageData.LP_MartialPower.label: martial power
LanguageData.LP_MartialPower.description: Power multiplier of DND martial techniques: 0.5 + Melee level / 20, plus the adventurer's higher of Strength or Dexterity modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02. Those with a martial class (fighter, monk, paladin, barbarian, ranger, rogue) add 0.02 × (combined martial class levels - 1), up to +40%. Second Wind healing, War Cry range, buff durations, monk fists and ki, and the paladin's Melee branch are all multiplied by it.
LanguageData.LP_MarksmanPower.label: marksman power
LanguageData.LP_MarksmanPower.description: Power multiplier of the DND fighter's Shooting branch: 0.5 + Shooting level / 20, plus adventurer Dexterity modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02; those with a martial class add 0.02 × (combined martial class levels - 1), up to +40%.
LanguageData.LP_DivinePower.label: divine power
LanguageData.LP_DivinePower.description: Divine magic power multiplier: 0.5 + Social level / 20, plus adventurer Wisdom or Charisma modifier (the higher; clerics use Wisdom, paladins Charisma) × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02. Used by cleric divine magic and the paladin's Social branch (Lay on Hands, Aura of Protection, Banish Evil).
